headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty hit nine-month highs as markets extended their winning streak to four consecutive weeks.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FII buying has driven Indian indices to hit nine-month highs during a sustained four-week rally.
Banking and IT stocks provided crucial support for a recovery during the midday session on November 20.
The market successfully overcame early pressure from a global AI sector selloff and hawkish Fed signals.
Strong weekly gains of approximately 3% for the NIFTY50 and SENSEX bolstered investor confidence.
whatHappening: NSE's own stock price has surged 35% from its October low, recently rallying 5% on significant trading volume.
Silver prices are experiencing a major downturn, falling 65% from their peak levels.
Noel Tata is preparing for a potentially stormy Tata Sons board meeting scheduled for next week.
Negotiators are discussing a fitment factor of 3.833 for the upcoming 8th Pay Commission.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian markets recovered from early losses to extend a four-week winning streak, with major indices reaching nine-month highs. While global AI selloffs and interest rate concerns caused initial volatility, banking and IT sectors led a successful recovery. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will resume operations on Monday.
